name: Lukewarmness
overview: Scripture reveals lukewarmness as a spiritual weakness characterized by divided loyalty and failure to fully commit to God's work. The Reubenites' hesitation to assist in battle (Judges 5:16) and the nobles of Tekoa refusing to 'put their necks to the work of their Lord' (Nehemiah 3:5) illustrate this reluctance. Likewise, the neglect of the house of God (Nehemiah 13:11) and the failure to uphold truth and righteousness (Jeremiah 9:3; Ezekiel 13:5) demonstrate a heart weakened by compromise and sin (Ezekiel 16:30). These examples underscore the danger of a half-hearted faith that neither fully embraces God's calling nor stands firm in His truth.
